headline: Sales and operating income rise from a year ago
summary_short: Daiwa House revenue was ¥1,504.3B, up 12.4% y/y and 6.8% q/q; operating income was ¥120.3B, up 16.5% y/y.
summary_long: Net income of ¥66.9B was up 8.9% y/y and down 19.6% q/q from ¥83.2B. EPS of ¥54.02 fell 45.6% y/y from ¥99.37 even though net income rose; the two come from different shard feeds and may not be on the same basis.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Shard EPS and net income move in opposite directions; treat the EPS delta with caution. Fiscal year ends in March, so the shard period label may not match the issuer's fiscal quarter.
